query: The scorecard shows engineering/build is flat: with-skill and without-skill answers scored the same, and reading them, the two answers really are similar. Improve it.
expected_behavior: Diagnoses the cause as a weak body because the two outputs are similar, rather than assuming the rubric is coarse
Makes one targeted source change that adds an observable step or refusal the base model skips, without padding
Rebuilds and validates before calling improve.py remeasure
Keeps the change only on a KEEP verdict; reverts on REVERT, and treats NEW BASELINE or UNCALIBRATED as no verdict requiring the protocol recovery step
Records a measured lift only after a valid comparable verdict; does not claim improvement from raw scores or opinion
